# PhoneFarm ICU (phonefarm.icu)

> Guangzhou real-device phone farm hardware supplier. B2B catalog and quote website.

## What we are
PhoneFarm ICU designs and assembles phone farm racks, motherboard boxes, fan cooling modules, USB hubs, power supplies, and network hardware for device labs and mobile testing environments. Buyers request written quotes — this is not a SaaS or cloud phone platform.

## Product lines
- Rack systems: full-phone enclosures for QA and device management
- Motherboard box systems: screenless Android density deployments
- Cooling & power: PSU and fan modules for stable rack operation
- USB, network & cabling: hubs, routers, setup services
